QuestInfo.name: How to Stuff Your Face
QuestInfo.0: Learn how to use consumable items from Mai.
QuestInfo.1:
Learn how to use consumable items from Mai.

#b#eTip:#n Munch on different items in the Use inventory for various effects. Press [I] to see what items you have. This key can be changed in the Keyboard Settings in the menu.#k
QuestInfo.2:
You have learned how to use consumable items from Mai.

#b#eTip:#n Munch on different items in the Use inventory for various effects. Press [I] to see what items you have. This key can be changed in the Keyboard Settings in the menu.#k

0.0: If you ever find yourself in a pickle, you can use\r\n#bconsumable#k items, found in the Use tab of your\r\ninventory. Just double-click!
0.1: Here, try it out by eating this apple. Just press #b[I]#k, then double-click the apple.

yes.0: I'll even give you more apples after you've finished chomping on that one! Just press #b[I]#k, then double-click the apple.

no.0: I didn't poison it! I would never do that to my best friend in the entire world, no matter how jealous I was! Talk to me again and choose 'yes'!

1.0: WOW, I've never seen anyone eat with such amazing technique! Maple World is full of stuff for you to munch on, just remember to check the effects before you put anything in your mouth.

yes.0: You're so good at everything you do. Here, take this apple. And this one. And here are a few more for good measure. You know, you might want to drag these apples to the #bhotkey window#k to access them more easily.

default.0: You still have the apple I gave you! I know eating is really intimidating, but I believe in you! Just press #b[I]#k, then double-click the apple.
